pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ tǎ wéi jiāo lái de yìxiàng zhǐ fàngdào yìbiān , xiān cóng yǐzi shàng ná qǐ zìjǐ de wǔfàn . " zuò . chàdiǎn ràng nǐ zuò bǐng shàng . "
pairs.english: Ruanheng set Tavi's preference sheet aside and lifted his lunch from the chair. “Sit. Nearly made you sit on my flatbread.”
pairs.hanzi:
阮衡把塔维交来的意向纸放到一边，先从椅子上拿起自己的午饭。
“坐。差点让你坐饼上。”

pairs.target: tā bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎngxiàng zhōng niánqīng , tóufa jiǎn dé duǎn , yīlǐng nèicè yǒu yìxiǎokuài méi xǐdiào de huī .
pairs.english: He was younger than Tavi had imagined, hair cropped short, an unwashed gray patch inside his collar.
pairs.hanzi: 他比塔维想象中年轻，头发剪得短，衣领内侧有一小块没洗掉的灰。

pairs.target: bái jiē bìyè shíyīnián , rújīn zài hé lù suǒ zuò xúnjiǎn , guǎn de búshì yízuò chénglǐ de lù , érshì jǐchù gòngtóng chūqián , gòngtóng shǐyòng de tōnglù . tā lái xuéxiào búshì lǐng yígè fēngěi zìjǐ de xuéshēng , xiān dé liáo míngbái , shuāngfāng cáinéng dìng .
pairs.english: Eleven years out of White Steps, he inspected for the Joint Routes Office: roads funded and used by several places, beyond one city's streets. He wasn't collecting an assigned student; both sides needed to talk before agreeing.
pairs.hanzi: 白阶毕业十一年，如今在合路所做巡检，管的不是一座城里的路，而是几处共同出钱、共同使用的通路。他来学校不是领一个分给自己的学生，先得聊明白，双方才能定。

pairs.target: zhè shì huíxiào hòu de dìèrgè shàngwǔ . wéi lǎoshī gēnjù tǎ wéi xiě de dōngxī , jiāng tā jièshào dào zhèlǐ , yòu bǎ yǐ tōngguò de nà jǐxiàng jìlù jiāogěi ruǎn héng .
pairs.english: It was the second morning after his return. Based on Tavi's stated interests, Vey had introduced him here and passed his completed assessment records to Ruanheng.
pairs.hanzi: 这是回校后的第二个上午。维老师根据塔维写的东西，将他介绍到这里，又把已通过的那几项记录交给阮衡。

pairs.target: liǎng rén shuō guò tā de shǒushàng běnshì , yě shuō guò shénme hái méi xué wěn , méiyǒu bǎ xīn shàng guò de chuánrè kè suàn chéng néng chūmén tìrén gànhuó de zīgé .
pairs.english: They had discussed his practical skills and what remained unreliable, without treating his new heat-transfer classes as a qualification to work for others outside.
pairs.hanzi: 两人说过他的手上本事，也说过什么还没学稳，没有把新上过的传热课算成能出门替人干活的资格。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià , fāxiàn zhuōxià yǒu yìshuāng xiǎo xuēzǐ . ruǎn héng kànjiàn tā de mùguāng , shuō tì nǚér nálái xiū de , zǎoshàng chūmén wàng le sòng , biéyǐwéi zìjǐ yòu cóng xuéxiào tōu le yìshuāng . wūlǐ yuányǒu de jǐnbēng yíxià sōng le xiē .
pairs.english: Sitting, Tavi noticed little boots beneath the table. Ruanheng said they were his daughter's, brought for repair but forgotten this morning, not another pair stolen from school. The room's tension eased.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维坐下，发现桌下有一双小靴子。阮衡看见他的目光，说替女儿拿来修的，早上出门忘了送，别以为自己又从学校偷了一双。
屋里原有的紧绷一下松了些。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng dǎkāi dàilái de bù juàn , lǐmiàn búshì qìjù , shì jǐzhāng bèi yǔlín zhòu de tú . yǒu de huà zhe qiáo , yǒu de zhǐyǒu yìtiáo guò shuǐ de gōu , pángbiān xiě zhe lùshang néng yòng nǎ chù dìfāng duī dōngxī . zuì hòu de yìdié , jìngshì měicì huílái hòu tiān guò de biān zhù .
pairs.english: Ruanheng opened his cloth roll: not apparatus but rain-wrinkled drawings, bridges on some, a watercourse on others, notes about roadside storage space. The thickest stack was marginal additions from each return visit.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡打开带来的布卷，里面不是器具，是几张被雨淋皱的图。有的画着桥，有的只有一条过水的沟，旁边写着路上能用哪处地方堆东西。最厚的一叠，竟是每次回来后添过的边注。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiě xiǎng zhīdào lù wèishénme néng zǒu . " tā shuō , " shì xiǎng kàn biérén zěnme shīshù , háishì xiǎng zhīdào yìtiáo lù huài zài nǎlǐ ? "
pairs.english: “You wrote that you want to know why roads can be used,” he said. “Do you want to watch casting, or know where a road has failed?”
pairs.hanzi: “你写想知道路为什么能走。”他说，“是想看别人怎么施术，还是想知道一条路坏在哪里？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu jí zhe dá , bǎ shí zhuó xiān yīn shuǐ tínggōng , hòulái jiù péng tiě yàng yòu biàn de shì jiǎng chūlái . tā zhī jiǎng zìjǐ kànjiàn hé hòulái nài lěi shuō qīng de bùfen . ruǎn héng tīng wán , wèn ruò méiyǒu hòutou tiě yàng nàjiànshì , qiántou de tínggōng suànbusuàn zhídé xiě .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't rush, describing Stonewash's water stoppage and later old-shed iron changes, only what he had seen or Nerai explained. Ruanheng asked whether the earlier stoppage deserved recording without the later iron incident.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有急着答，把石濯先因水停工、后来旧棚铁样又变的事讲出来。他只讲自己看见和后来奈蕾说清的部分。阮衡听完，问若没有后头铁样那件事，前头的停工算不算值得写。

pairs.target: " dāngrán suàn . yǒurén nà bàntiān méiyǒu gōngqián . " " nà zhèfèn huó nǐ wèibì huì xián quán wú yìsī . "
pairs.english: “Of course. Some people lost half a day's pay.” “Then you might not find this job entirely uninteresting.”
pairs.hanzi:
“当然算。有人那半天没有工钱。”
“那这份活你未必会嫌全无意思。”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng fānkāi yìzhāng tú . mǒu duàn lùbiān gōu cháng yū , chūqián zuì duō de cāng xíng xiǎng ràng tāmen xiānchá gāochù de qiáo , yīnwèi zhòng chē duō děng yìtiān yào péiqián ; gòngyòng nàtiáo lù de zhùhù què yào xiān kàn xiàmiàn de chūshuǐkǒu , shuǐ jìnmén shí , qiáo zài hǎo yě yòngbúshàng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng opened a drawing. A roadside ditch often silted up. The biggest warehouse funder wanted the upper bridge checked first, heavy-cart delays costing money; households sharing the road wanted the lower outlet first, since a good bridge meant nothing when water entered their homes.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡翻开一张图。某段路边沟常淤，出钱最多的仓行想让他们先查高处的桥，因为重车多等一天要赔钱；共用那条路的住户却要先看下面的出水口，水进门时，桥再好也用不上。

pairs.target: liǎngchù dōu búshì jiǎbào , xúnjiǎn de rén dé fēnqīng yǎnqián xiān zuò shénme , lìngwài yíchù zěnyàng jiāodài .
pairs.english: Neither report was false; inspectors had to distinguish what to do first and how to account for the other place.
pairs.hanzi: 两处都不是假报，巡检的人得分清眼前先做什么、另外一处怎样交代。

pairs.english: Tavi asked who decided. Ruanheng tapped the paper: sometimes he set inspection order, sometimes he brought disagreements back to the office; this uniform didn't let him divide everyone's roads and money for them.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问最后谁说了算。阮衡敲敲纸，说有时自己能定检查次序，有时得把不同意见带回所里，不能因为穿了这件衣服，就代几处人把钱和路都分完。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán cái fāxiànzìjǐ hái chuānzhe pǔtōng duǎnguà , dītóu kànkàn , xiào le yíxià . " fǎnzhèng búshì yīfu de běnshì . "
pairs.english: Only then did he notice his ordinary short jacket. He looked down and laughed. “Anyway, the clothes don't do it.”
pairs.hanzi:
他说完才发现自己还穿着普通短褂，低头看看，笑了一下。
“反正不是衣服的本事。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě xiào le , què yòu wèn gēn gǎng de rén huì buhuì zhǐshì tì tā chāo nàxiē zhēnglùn . ruǎn héng shuō huì chāo , yě huì liáng , huì duì jiù jìlù , héshì de zhuāngpèi huì ràng tā zuò ; kě bìng búshì měitiān dōu yǒu yíjiàn néng yòng jiè xìng xiǎnchū běnshì de shì .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed too, but asked if placements only copied those arguments. Ruanheng said copying, measuring and comparing old records, with suitable assembly work too; not every day brought a chance to shine through property borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也笑了，却又问跟岗的人会不会只是替他抄那些争论。阮衡说会抄，也会量、会对旧记录，合适的装配会让他做；可并不是每天都有一件能用借性显出本事的事。

pairs.target: zìjǐ yào de shì yǒurén néng gàosù tā nǎ yíyè duìbúshàng , búshì pángbiān duō yìshuāng zhī huì diǎntóu de yǎnjīng . zhèhuà tīng zhe bù quán hǎotīng , tǎ wéi què juéde bǐ shuō shénme dōu néng xué gèng shízài .
pairs.english: He wanted someone who would tell him which page didn't match, not just another pair of eyes nodding beside him. Not entirely flattering, Tavi thought, but more honest than promising he could learn everything.
pairs.hanzi:
自己要的是有人能告诉他哪一页对不上，不是旁边多一双只会点头的眼睛。
这话听着不全好听，塔维却觉得比说什么都能学更实在。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng qǐng tā bǎ zuì shú de yíxiàng zuòfǎ cóng zhǔnbèi jiǎng dào shōuwěi . tā jiǎng le pèi hǎo de tiě jiàn , dǐzuò hé duǎn xiāo , yòu jiǎng zìjǐ yǒu yícì chàdiǎn hūlüè huàngdòng de diànmù .
pairs.english: Ruanheng asked him to describe his most familiar procedure from preparation to finish. He described matched iron, base and short pin, and once nearly missing a wobbling support block.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡请他把最熟的一项做法从准备讲到收尾。他讲了配好的铁件、底座和短销，又讲自己有一次差点忽略晃动的垫木。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu jiào tā xiànchǎng lòuyìshǒu , zhī wèn zhèxiē dōngxī búpèi hǎo , hái néng bunéng zhàoyàngzuò . tā shuō bùnéng . " nà xíng . xiān bié bǎ huì tíngxiàlái zhèjiàn shì diūdiào . "
pairs.english: Ruanheng didn't demand a demonstration, only asked if he could still do it without matching the materials. No. “Good. Don't lose the ability to stop.”
pairs.hanzi:
阮衡没有叫他现场露一手，只问这些东西不配好，还能不能照样做。
他说不能。
“那行。先别把会停下来这件事丢掉。”

pairs.target: gōngqián hé chàlǚ àn xuéxiào yǔ suǒ lǐ yǐjīng tán hǎo de bànfǎ zǒu , chī zhù yǒurén ānpái , fǎnxiào fùchá yě zài shíliù zhōu lǐ , bù cóng xuéshēng xiēxī de rìzi kòu .
pairs.english: Pay and travel followed the academy-office agreement, food and lodging arranged, school reviews included in the sixteen weeks without deducting students' rest days.
pairs.hanzi: 工钱和差旅按学校与所里已经谈好的办法走，吃住有人安排，返校复查也在十六周里，不从学生歇息的日子扣。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng xiěmíng de nà zhāng zhǐ tuī gěi tā , ràng tā náhuíqù kàn , sāntiān hòu xiān gēn bàntiān jìn chéng de huó , kàn wán zài juédìng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng pushed the written terms over for him to read at home: first a half day on a near-city job in three days, then decide.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将写明的那张纸推给他，让他拿回去看，三天后先跟半天近城的活，看完再决定。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tǎ wéi pèngjiàn děng zài láng xià de yīwén . tā qù de shì lìng yìjiān wū , xiǎng wèn tōnglù jiāojiē de jìlù dàodǐ zěnme yǐngxiǎng xiànchǎng de rén , méi yīn fùqīn shúrén duō jiù yǐjīng dìng hǎo .
pairs.english: Outside Tavi met Iven waiting in the corridor, headed to another room to ask how route-handover records affected people on site. His father's contacts hadn't settled it for him.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，塔维碰见等在廊下的伊文。他去的是另一间屋，想问通路交接的记录到底怎么影响现场的人，没因父亲熟人多就已经定好。

pairs.target: mǐlā hái zài zuōfang nà tóu , zhèng tóng yíwèi lái dài rén de shījiě zhēng , tā de xiǎoyàng néng bunéng suàn jìn wǎnghòu yào jìxù zuò de shì .
pairs.english: Mira was still at the workshop, arguing with a visiting graduate supervisor about continuing her prototype in the work ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉还在作坊那头，正同一位来带人的师姐争，她的小样能不能算进往后要继续做的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi tì tā hǎn . tā dītóu kàn ruǎn héng xiě de jíhé chù , zhǐ jiǎo yǒu yìxiǎokuài bǐng yóu , zìjì què qīngchǔ . nàge rén hái méi chéng zìjǐ de shīfu , zhuōshàng yě méiyǒu bǎi yíkuài yuèjiè kè de bái pái , piānpiān ràng tā bǐ zǎoshàng láishí gèng xiǎng qù kànkàn .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't call for her. He looked at Ruanheng's meeting place, a small grease mark on the paper but clear writing. The man wasn't his supervisor yet, no Outrider tally on the desk, yet Tavi wanted to see the job more than when he had arrived that morning.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没替她喊。他低头看阮衡写的集合处，纸角有一小块饼油，字迹却清楚。那个人还没成自己的师傅，桌上也没有摆一块越界客的白牌，偏偏让他比早上来时更想去看看。
